# Minimal Premium Clarity

Skin ID: `minimal-premium`

Public name: Minimal Premium Clarity

Mood: quiet luxury, clean, restrained, typography-first.

Best-fit niches: nutrition, general wellness, gut, sleep, premium personal coaching.

Visual metaphor: a high-end minimal wellness consultancy page.

Structure:
- Hero: typography-first with calm portrait and whitespace.
- Background: static neutral texture.
- Cards: divider cards with thin lines and little shadow.
- CTA: simple confident dark CTA.
- Navbar: clean text-led nav.
- Sticky CTA: minimal CTA bar.
- Bonus: clean product list/cards.
- FAQ: text-only line accordion.
- Media: restrained portrait block.
- Motion: almost none.
- Mobile: readable spacing without giant empty gaps.

Difference from default: removes glass-heavy rhythm, uses line/list structures, static texture, quiet typography, and minimal FAQ.

Must not change: CTA href, Google Form behavior, legal/support links, analytics, bonus service names, FAQ data, inspect slot keys.
